notes.title: Offical Roadmap & What’s Next
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone!ːsteamhappyː
We’re incredibly excited to share the [b]official roadmap[/b] for [b][i]Coffie Simulator[/i][/b]— outlining our plans from the current demo phase all the way to version [b]1.0[/b]![/p][p]This roadmap highlights the [b]core systems already in[/b], what’s coming in [b]Early Access[/b], and our goals [b]beyond that[/b]. It includes everything from deeper coffee-making mechanics, more content (teas, foods, events), to multiplayer and mod support![/p][p]
